We recognize that queer and trans people are too often dismissed, ignored or condescended to as they navigate healthcare systems that aren’t equipped to serve them. Script’s mission is to deliver crucial, timely stories about LGBTQ2S+ health that actually reflect readers’ perspectives, experiences and unique healthcare needs. We aim to have our coverage capture the complexity of how factors such as race, class, citizenship status and disability affect the ways people move through the world and the impacts this has on health outcomes. We believe that access to equitable healthcare is a human right. We believe that discussions about our health should be frank, but that there’s also room for irreverence and fun. We believe that factual, reliable healthcare information can empower people to improve their own well-being. We are pro-queer, pro-sex and pro-bodily autonomy. While we will offer plenty of advice, we won’t be prescriptive—we won’t talk down to you, and we will push beyond the status quo. Our name reflects our desire to flip the script: we harness storytelling, community engagement and evidenced-based reporting to help LGBTQ2S+ people take charge of their health.

Grâce à la croissance rapide de ses réseaux de distribution et de collaborateurs, Graffici s’est vite imposé comme un média gaspésien incontournable.

D’abord tourné vers le secteur culturel, GRAFFICI franchit une nouvelle étape en 2007 en devenant un journal généraliste. Il offre dès lors des dossiers fouillés, des chroniques et des opinions touchant tant les affaires sociales qu’économiques et politiques, sans délaisser la culture et les sports.

C’est en 2011 que l’entreprise s’ancre sur le Web avec une plateforme d’information régionale. Ce lieu d’échanges offre du contenu diversifié ouvert aux commentaires afin de permettre à tous de prendre part au débat public et de pousser plus loin la réflexion sur les enjeux de la région.

En 2015, plusieurs blogueurs bénévoles se joignent à l’équipe lorsque Graffici prend un virage vers les affaires publiques, l’humeur et l’opinion. Ainsi, le site Web propose alors du contenu exclusif comme des billets, des récits et de la poésie bien sentis sur une foule de sujets qui sauront tantôt émouvoir, tantôt faire réagir ou simplement divertir.

Encore aujourd’hui, des articles étoffés, rédigés par une équipe de journalistes chevronnés, permettent de suivre les grands dossiers qui préoccupent les Gaspésiennes et les Gaspésiens. La version imprimée du journal Graffici est distribuée six fois par année.

Name: The Media Bias Meter
Description:
Media Bias Meter is an independent research and analytics organization dedicated to improving transparency and accountability in news reporting. We specialize in monitoring how major media outlets cover key global events and public-interest issues, using a combination of quantitative analysis, linguistic metrics, and data-driven methodologies.

Our team tracks large volumes of news content across multiple countries and languages, identifying patterns in language, framing, context, and sourcing. We translate these findings into clear, evidence-based bias scores that help journalists, researchers, policymakers, and the public better understand how narratives are constructed and where imbalances may occur.

Our mission is to support a healthier information ecosystem by providing rigorous, non-partisan insights that encourage accuracy, fairness, and transparency in media coverage. We collaborate with academic partners, civil-society organizations, and cross-disciplinary experts to continually refine our tools and expand the scope of our reporting.

At Media Bias Meter, we believe informed audiences are essential to strong democracies—and that trustworthy analysis empowers people to interpret the news with greater clarity and confidence.

Name: Sports Digital Network
Description:
Sports Digital Network (SDN) is Canada's Contextual Digital Video & OOH Network.

We help brands extend CTV, social video and out-of-home campaigns into the real world - reaching active Canadians where community life happens.

Our network spans 100+ premium sport and recreation facilities across Canada, plus 26 ClubLink private golf clubs across Ontario, delivering more than 1 billion annual impressions in some of the country's highest-attention environments.

These environments include:

• Community arenas
• Indoor soccer centres
• Multi-sport complexes
• Recreation facilities
• ClubLink private golf clubs
 
All of our adds are full screen and in prominent facility locations. 

Because most media plans are built around reach and impressions; SDN adds a complementary layer: real-world attention, contextual relevance and community participation.

We act as a “multiplier”- extending video reach, OOH attention and local relevance to where your audience visits multiple times a week. SDN is a layer that extends reach beyond traditional media channels alone.

After all, consumer decisions don't stop when they leave their couch.

For advertisers, SDN helps:

• Extend existing video and OOH investments
• Add true incremental reach to CTV, social video and OOH plans 
• Reach audiences where they actively participate week after week
• Deliver messaging in trusted, contextually relevant environments
• Combine national scale with local market relevance
• Follow audiences, not screens
 
As local media has fragmented and community participation has grown, SDN helps brands reconnect with Canadians in the places where real-world attention still matters.

The strongest media plans follow people.

Name: Explore Outdoor Media Inc.

Name: Le Pigeon Dissident
Description:
Le Pigeon Dissident est le journal étudiant de la Faculté de droit de l'Université de Montréal, au Québec. Il s'agit d'un mensuel publié en format papier et Web.

Créé en 1974, le journal est écrit et géré par les étudiants de droit. Les publications se composent de textes d'opinions juridiques et politiques, d'entrevues ainsi que d'une section culturelle avec des critiques de livres, de films et de pièces de théâtre. Sont également publiés des textes de collaborateurs internationaux, essentiellement des étudiants de la Faculté participant à des programmes d'échanges.

Le Pigeon Dissident est distribué dans les murs de la Faculté de droit, sur le campus de l'Université de Montréal ainsi que chez certains collaborateurs du milieu juridique et non-juridique.

Name: Mary Ann Shadd Cary Centre for Journalism and Belonging
Description:
Housed at Carleton University’s School of Journalism and Communications, the Centre conducts research, creates community-focused journalism and networking opportunities for equity- deserving groups, produces research-based journalism that Centers belonging, and archives all associated work, creation and activities. Through research, student training, community building and media production, and by partnering with industry organizations, community leaders and youth, the Centre will focus on race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, socioeconomic status and the intersections therein to foster a more inclusive journalism industry.

The Mary Ann Shadd Cary Centre for Journalism and Belonging was founded in 2023 by journalist and educator @nanaabaduncan with permission from the Shadd family to emphasize Shadd Cary’s contribution to journalism in Canada.
